node: InP wafers, photodetectors, lasers, optical engines, and alternative photonics platforms
summary: Direct public-company exposure to the InP / photonics capacity node is concentrated in a small set of obvious leaders plus a narrower underfollowed lane. The strongest reference names are the established optical-component vendors with direct InP dependency and the hyperscaler/customer anchor NVIDIA. The underfollowed discovery lane is led by alternative integration platforms that may reduce dependence on native InP substrate capacity, but these remain hypothesis-level until commercial volume, customer wins, or signed capacity agreements are verified. Overall, the most important research question is whether hyperscaler pre-buying and AI optics demand are creating a durable capacity bottleneck in InP-based devices and whether alternative silicon-based photonics can scale fast enough to matter.
